snippet.title: Prism Cross - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Prism Cross is FINALLY OUT!

Direct Download Links:
(Attention: Due to high traffic and Google limitations, please log into your Gmail when accessing Drive links.)
Full Version (v1.06) - https://drive.google.com/file/d/1B8c2Gp3NhoafUUEEQD-cPco-6j7-Sgms/view?usp=drive_link
Patch Only - https://drive.google.com/file/d/1rdnznhPHVuBcgoz0CYqeNRIMwsXPWYU9/view?usp=drive_link

Website: https://prismcross.neocities.org/
itch.io: https://prismcross.itch.io/prism-cross
Discord: https://discord.gg/qsp5X6PEFh

Prism Cross is a new platfighter game created by the team behind CMC+.
Duke it out utilizing fresh and exciting new mechanics, with a diverse roster of faces both familiar and novel!
Those visiting the realm of Prism Cross can expect the following:
-A visually unified and reasonably balanced roster.
-New features and mechanics.
-A launch roster of about 50 characters, focusing on the quality of the game vs strictly adding everything under the sun.
-And much more!

Keep an eye out for news to come. Look up high with vigor!
